kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تفاضلت (form VI)
# تَفَاضَلْتُ (tafāḍaltu) /ta.faː.dˤal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# تَفَاضَلْتَ (tafāḍalta) /ta.faː.dˤal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# تَفَاضَلْتِ (tafāḍalti) /ta.faː.dˤal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# تَفَاضَلَتْ (tafāḍalat) /ta.faː.dˤa.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
